verdict.rationale: Riveter's marketing site says any project can be scheduled to monitor for changes on a recurring basis, refreshing as often as every minute. That is a product-owned recurring schedule, not a one-off run. However, the API docs, OpenAPI excerpts and Go SDK never mention a scheduling endpoint or parameter, so it is unclear whether developers can set schedules programmatically or pick specific run times. missing for 10: API/SDK scheduling interface, specific time-of-day or cron-style scheduling, detailed scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times

citations.quote: Schedule any project to monitor for changes and keep your data fresh.
For fast moving data like scores or election results, you can refresh as often as every minute.
